overall: The Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law: it timely answered the minutes request by explaining the minutes did not yet exist, and no continuing duty required later production.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board failed to provide September 14, 2022 meeting minutes once drafted, after initially responding that the minutes did not yet exist.
allegations.key_passage: The Board had an obligation to respond to the September 14 request for minutes within 10 days by providing any minutes that existed, whether in draft or final form, and explaining whether any requested minutes did not exist.
